items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty signals negative open; Asia markets advance as tech shares rise
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a negative open for the Nifty50 index. Asian markets extended gains as technology shares continued to advance

items.title: Coal India unit Mahanadi Coalfields lists at 2% discount to IPO price
items.description: The price band for Mahanadi Coalfields IPO was set at ₹129 to ₹136 per share.
